articles.title: South Korea to bring digital assets under new state asset management system
articles.snippet: South Korea’s Economy Ministry plans to include digital assets and intellectual property under the country’s new state-asset management framework.

articles.title: Czech Republic tells ISPs to block Polymarket after gambling blacklisting
articles.snippet: The Czech Finance Ministry added Polymarket to its blacklist of unauthorized online gambling websites, requiring internet providers to block access within 15 days.

articles.title: DeepMind CEO Says AGI Will Be Bigger Than Electricity or Fire
articles.snippet: Demis Hassabis says artificial general intelligence is only a few years away and proposes a new U.S. standards body to test frontier AI models before release.
